## Page 10

10Gross Margin Erosion Drives Net Profit Down 28%, Partial Buffer 
from Cost Control
Net profit declined 28% YoY (THB 169M vs. THB 235M) due to the acute drop in gross profit margin. 
This decline was partially offset by effective management of operating costs and expenses and 
the absence of a significant impairment charge recognized in the prior year.Negative driver:
•Gross Profit margin shrank sharply 
(from 17.1% to 13.2%) due to the 
strong appreciation of the Thai 
Baht and higher raw material costs.
Positive driver:
•OPEX decreased 5.2% YoY (THB 156M 
vs. THB 165M) , demonstrating 
effective cost management.
•Lower Income tax expense from BOI 
tax privilege (+12MB).
•Higher non -controlling interests 
(+34MB).
Opportunity Day Q3Y25 (Nov 26th, 2025)

24Q3Y25 Performance Drivers:
•Sales volume surged 26% YoY and revenue climbed 25% YoY to THB 247 million. 
•The primary growth driver was the recovery of the domestic shrimp farming industry, which entered its high production season in 
the Eastern and Southern regions. 
•The Company effectively managed its cost structure despite an increase in the price of key raw materials like Fishmeal. 
•New feed formulas successfully improved aquatic survival rate and lowered the Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR), enhancing client 
productivity.
9M Strategy:
•For the nine -month period, the 7% YoY decline in sales and revenue was a deliberate result of strategic customer portfolio 
optimization. 
•The Company focused on clients with strong payment potential and financial discipline to mitigate bad debt risk.

26Q3Y25 Performance & Decline:

•Sales in the Japan, US, and Australia markets continued to show a healthy recovery, for shrimp.
•Orders from the Australian market helped compensate for the US slowdown.
Q4 Outlook:
•Q4 anticipates significant QoQ growth, driven by an acceleration of purchase orders from the US market, particularly for 
higher -margin VAP.
